doc.name: G — 30s charity impact story set in a suburban home, melancholic in tone, a family of three, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: charity impact story set in a suburban home, melancholic in tone
Hero: a family of three
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the charity impact story set in a suburban home, melancholic in tone form, built around a family of three.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. The hero prop introduced in Act 1 must be physically present in Acts 2 and 3.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a boom-down from a high wide to a tight insert in Act 1 against a whip pan that resolves onto the subject in Act 3 — while holding the near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second charity impact story set in a suburban home, melancholic in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same family of three.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a whip pan that resolves onto the subject, shot on a 50mm normal at f/2.8, framed with a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with scrim-diffused midday daylight, one stop under the ambient; grade as warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second charity impact story set in a suburban home, melancholic in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same family of three.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a rack focus pulling from foreground occlusion to the subject, shot on an 85mm short telephoto at f/2, framed with frame-within-frame using foreground architecture.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill; grade as Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.negative_prompt: distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second charity impact story set in a suburban home, melancholic in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same family of three.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a snap zoom in followed by a settle, shot on a 40mm anamorphic at f/4, framed with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject; grade as Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
